text:
Maya (CS): AcmeCorp returned the vendor risk form — two blockers called out: BYOK/KMS provenance and embeddings retention/pseudonymization. They want evidence and a suggested retention policy. Putting the thread here for handback and renewal impact.

Ravi (Security): Got it. Which exact artifacts do they want for KMS? key provenance, rotation policy, HSM attestation?

Maya (CS): They listed: key provenance + where keys are stored (BYOK vs managed), rotation cadence, and a one-page attestation for SOC2 evidence. For embeddings: retention length and whether we store raw PII.

Jon (Engineering): We currently persist embeddings in S3 for analytics and ranking traces, default TTL 90d. We can add lifecycle rule to 30d if that helps. No per-tenant model weights are stored.

Ravi (Security): 30d purge is fine. For the KMS attestation, we can provide KMS config + our KMS vendor attestation PDF. If customer insists on BYOK, we need to confirm support matrix for their cloud key provider.

Maya (CS): Can we produce the following by EOD tomorrow? (1) architecture diagram for data flow and where embeddings are stored, (2) KMS attestation doc, (3) short note on pseudonymization steps. Renewal owner flagged this as a potential risk if not answered within 72h.

Jon (Engineering): I can export the architecture diagram and add the S3 lifecycle change. Lifecycle rule snippet I will apply:

```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-embeddings --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"purge-embeddings-30d","Status":"Enabled","Filter":{"Prefix":"embeddings/"},"Expiration":{"Days":30}}]}'
```

Jon (Engineering): ETA for diagram + lifecycle change: tomorrow morning. I'll drop the link when done.

Ravi (Security): For pseudonymization, we can provide the processing steps: tokenization + hashing + access controls. There's an internal note at https://drive.company/secure/pseudonymization-v1 (shareable doc). I'll attach the sanitized excerpt for customer.

Lina (Account Exec): If BYOK is required and we can't support their KMS vendor, renewal risk becomes medium-high. Suggest offering a 30-day security review call and a pilot extension to mitigate. I'll be on the call.

DeployBot: `INFRA` s3-lifecycle rule created by jon at 1769504375 — rule id purge-embeddings-30d :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): Perfect — next steps for handback: I will assemble a single packet with the diagram, KMS attestation PDF, excerpt from pseudonymization doc, and the lifecycle confirmation. Draft message to customer below — please thumbs up or edit.

Maya (CS): "Hi Amy — thanks for the follow-up. We've attached an architecture diagram that shows where embeddings are stored, our KMS attestation, and a short note on how we pseudonymize and purge embeddings. We've also applied a 30-day lifecycle rule to embeddings in S3 and can discuss BYOK options on a quick call. Would you be available Wed or Thu for a 30-min security review?

Looking forward,
Maya on behalf of Redwood Inference" :paperclip:

Ravi (Security): :thumbsup: I'll add the attestation PDF to the packet.

Jon (Engineering): :thumbsup: link to diagram + lifecycle audit log will be posted shortly.

Lina (Account Exec): :eyes: I'll propose times for the security review and prepare the renewal mitigation note.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll upload the packet to the case and ping AcmeCorp once Jon and Ravi confirm uploads. Tracking this as renewal-risk:moderate until BYOK question resolved.
